GUARD_A_SIGNED_TOPOLOGY_ADDED.why: absolute-correlation targets cannot distinguish realistic structure from excess anti-correlation
GUARD_A_SIGNED_TOPOLOGY_ADDED.finding_that_changed_the_design: real RNA is nearly SIGN-BALANCED at a ratio of 1.12. This falsified the initial 'coherent positive blocks' hypothesis, which would have driven that ratio far above 1, and redirected the design to coherent MAGNITUDE with BALANCED signs.

GUARD_B_DONOR_RESAMPLED_ENVELOPES.unit: donor, because cells within a donor are not independent
GUARD_B_DONOR_RESAMPLED_ENVELOPES.why: the frozen point estimates are themselves sample statistics; calibrating to them exactly would be tuning to noise

LAYER_SEPARATION_REQUIRED_AND_PERFORMED.rule: latent eta geometry and observed-RNA geometry are measured and reported separately
LAYER_SEPARATION_REQUIRED_AND_PERFORMED.why: so a candidate cannot compensate for observation losses by making latent biology absurdly correlated

THE_LATENT_MECHANISM_IS_SOLVED.mechanism: coherent MAGNITUDE with BALANCED SIGNS, over a few dominant overlapping factors
derivation: independent normal loadings make correlation accumulate as a RANDOM WALK, because for two genes sharing a factor the product of their loadings has mean zero
the signed envelope shows real RNA is nearly sign-balanced, so coherent POSITIVE blocks are wrong
many factors DILUTE: at 400 factors each gene sits in about 12 and mean degree fell to zero
therefore variance must be dominated by a FEW factors that most genes share, which is also what var_top10_pc of 0.509 implies
THE_LATENT_MECHANISM_IS_SOLVED.reading: the latent layer reproduces real dependence geometry closely on five of six targets

THE_ABUNDANCE_PRIOR_IS_LOAD_BEARING.finding: the candidate harness initially omitted the registry-derived abundance prior that the real observer carries. Adding it restored anti-correlation from exactly zero to 0.1395 and raised mean degree from 197 to 943, with no change to the observation model.
THE_ABUNDANCE_PRIOR_IS_LOAD_BEARING.why: without a heavy-tailed abundance prior every address is equivalent, detection is near-binary, and censoring at zero destroys the negative tail of the correlation distribution entirely
THE_ABUNDANCE_PRIOR_IS_LOAD_BEARING.consequence: the observation model was NOT reopened on this evidence, which was the correct call

WHY_STEP_3_IS_NOT_CLOSED.binding_constraint: the observation model, not the latent generator
WHY_STEP_3_IS_NOT_CLOSED.systematic_failure: after observation the best candidates reach median |corr| about 0.22 against a target of 0.33, mean degree about 950 against 1686, transitivity about 0.55 against 0.86, while var_top10_pc runs HIGH at 0.68 against 0.509
WHY_STEP_3_IS_NOT_CLOSED.the_structural_trap: fewer dominant factors raise correlation but push the rank too low; more factors lower correlation. Within this model family the two cannot be satisfied together after observation.
WHY_STEP_3_IS_NOT_CLOSED.stopping_rule_invoked: the instruction was to stop and report if no simple factor model can do this, rather than tuning indefinitely. That condition is reached.

REOPENING_THE_OBSERVATION_MODEL_IS_NOW_W.precondition_stated_in_advance: only reopen the observation model if a good latent generator repeatedly fails after observation in a systematic way
evidence: a latent generator matching real geometry on five of six targets exists
it fails after observation across 13 candidates
the failure is systematic and directional: correlation is attenuated by about 40% while low-rank-ness is preserved or raised
the earlier Bernoulli alternative was already tested and did not help, so the replacement must be reasoned rather than guessed

FAILED_CANDIDATE_HISTORY_PRESERVED.reason: mid band diluted the dominant axes
more or stronger dominant factors monotonically worsened degree and correlation

WHAT_IS_NOT_CLAIMED: no candidate is frozen as the successor background
no world is regenerated and no 100K run is authorised
no threshold or target was moved at any point
no model has been trained and no biological interpretation is offered
STILL_OUTSTANDING_FROM_THE_MANDATE: item 6: the A_REPLICA control statistic is not yet defined or frozen
step 3 closure, pending the observation-model question
